_p226_note: Counts ROSE because these scanners started SEEING main.py, NOT because defects were added. Every read used encoding="utf-8" while main.py carries a UTF-8 BOM, so ast.parse raised SyntaxError on U+FEFF and the largest file in the repo was silently skipped for as long as these audits have existed. Attributed BEFORE re-baselining (P175): all 308 new silent_failure entries are main.py symbols (ExecutionContext.build_from_runner, MahalanobisOODDetector.load, *Config.from_dict ...), and both counts are now identical with and without the BOM. Same defect as P171 in lint_orphan_signal_reads.py, never applied here.
_p216_note: 336 was 334: +2 for CCNewsFeed._restore_state/_persist_state (P216). Both are deliberate fail-soft guards mirroring the accepted CryptoPanic precedent from P154 — a corrupt state file must not break startup, and telemetry must not break the tick. Both LOG on failure (warning / debug) and carry noqa: silent-swallow; this counter is produced by silent_failure_audit, which counts try/except blocks generally and is not noqa-aware. Updated this ONE counter by hand: --update re-seeds all seven baselines including mypy (P171).
